title: Resend header
description: A slim sticky bar on black: wordmark left, seven quiet grey links centred (most with a small chevron that dips on hover), log in and a graphite button right. It drops in from above on load, and gains a hairline and a blurred dark backdrop once the page scrolls. Phones get a menu button that opens a full-width link list.
notes: the hairline/backdrop fade is a CSS scroll() timeline; browsers without it show the solid bar from the start
needs JavaScript only for the phone menu
